_comment: VR facts. Sources and their trust levels are in docs/VR-SOURCES.md. Per-eye sizes are panel pixels; refresh lists are what the headset software offers.

fixed.label: VR pixel density
fixed.why: This headset is sharp enough at 1.0; a higher value renders pixels the lenses cannot show

fixed.label: VR bloom effect
fixed.why: Bloom shows visible seams when quad views (foveated rendering) is on

fixed.label: Lens effects
fixed.why: Lens effects show visible seams when quad views (foveated rendering) is on

fixed.label: Motion blur
fixed.why: Made for monitors; in a headset it smears the picture and can cause discomfort

fixed.label: Depth of field
fixed.why: Made for monitors; in a headset it blurs whatever you are not expected to look at
